description: Search US Customs (CBP) classification rulings — the case law of HS codes: how the border actually interprets what product belongs under which code. Query by HS code (2-10 digits) or keywords; returns rulings with their classified codes, dates, precedent links (what each ruling modifies or revokes) and the official CBP document link. Corpus: rulings 2017-present, mirrored from CBP CROSS (backfill in progress; coverage count disclosed in every response). No API key required.

query.description: HS code (e.g. 9401.61) or keywords (e.g. "electric standing desk")

name: rulings_search
title: CBP classification rulings search
